---
title: "Part 2 — Building"
---

Part 2 walks through building your first Pico end-to-end: authoring Rules,
running the Parser, and using the Composer to produce
`hello-world-pico`.

## Lessons

Lesson content for Part 2 is authored following the same lesson layout as
[Part 1, lesson 1](../part-1/01-introduction/index.qmd). This page will list
lessons as they are added.

::: {.callout-warning title="Scaffold — not yet runnable"}
Part 2 is intentionally scaffolded rather than written out in full. It
is included so the reference course demonstrates a multi-part
structure, but it does **not** yet carry runnable learner content.
Use the [Introduction lesson](../part-1/01-introduction/index.qmd) as
the canonical example of the lesson structure to follow.
:::
